van._note: s. 4.1(c): lawful testing ≤ 80 dBA at the point of reception or at least 6.1 m from the source, whichever is the greater; once a month, ≤ 60 min, daytime, plus once a year ≤ 180 min. Running in a power cut as emergency works, s. 4.3(c): our reading (?).

edm._note: C14600 s. 19(3), 21(3): daytime, up to 1 hour a day, 75 dB(A) at residential and 85 at non-residential property lines; ss. 20, 22: overnight 50 and 60, no allowance; s. 24: no generator exemption (a flag, not a block).
